subject: Portal evidence source verification and upload window
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@novafinance.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@novafinance.com
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal: source verification for SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're starting intake for NovaFinance's annual SOC 2 and SIG review and want to validate what evidence you intend to upload to Vendr vs. what you'll attach on the intake form. Two quick asks so we can scope the review: 

1) Can you confirm the canonical source for the SOC 2 bridge summary and who at Redwood will sign off on possession? We need a contact name + email for our attestations.
2) We have a short policy to verify where CAIQ answers were generated (doc repo vs. applied to the portal). If you can provide a one-paragraph source note for the CAIQ mapping and an approximate upload window (2–3 business days), that will help avoid duplicate requests from our auditors.

I attached a sample intake checklist for reference (upload-instructions.txt). If simpler, we can provision a temporary upload folder — let me know.

Best,
Lena
Lena Park
Senior Security Analyst, NovaFinance
attachments: upload-instructions.txt

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@novafinance.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal: source verification for SOC 2 artifacts

Lena — thanks for the note. Quick answers below and a proposed plan: 

1) Canonical sources and sign-off
- SOC 2 bridge summary: master doc lives in our internal Security Drive (Drive: /security/soc2/bridge-2027). Mateo Alvarez (mateo.alvarez@redwood.com) will be the point of contact and attestor for possession. Karthik will be backup reviewer for control mappings.
- SIG/CAIQ mapping: maintained in our compliance repo (sig/caiaq/mapping.xlsx) — we'll export the latest mapping and attach the spreadsheet you referenced (sig-caiaq-mapping.xlsx).

2) Source note and upload window
- Source note (one paragraph): "CAIQ answers reflect a consolidated mapping exported from Redwood's compliance repository (gitlab.com/redwood/compliance), with responses validated against our SOC 2 control evidence set (Drive:/security/soc2/bridge-2027). The attached spreadsheet includes references to internal artifacts (doc ids) and last validation timestamps."
- Upload window: we can upload to Vendr on Wed 2027-03-10 between 09:00–12:00 PT. If you prefer a presigned S3 link, please send it and we'll push earlier.

Attachments: I'll attach the SOC 2 bridge draft and the CAIQ mapping export in my next message. Priyom will handle the Vendr upload.

Action items: 
- Lena: confirm Vendr folder vs presigned link preference.
- Redwood: Mateo to share SOC 2 bridge PDF, Priyom to perform upload on Wednesday morning.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Security Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: none (bridge and mapping to follow)

From: Lena Park <lena.park@novafinance.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 16:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal: source verification for SOC 2 artifacts

Thanks Mateo — Vendr folder is fine, please name the files with the prefix NOVA-RE: that helps our tracker. I'm provisioning a temp upload folder and sending the link to security_ops@novafinance.com and your team now. Use the folder and the presign URL only — do not post artifacts in plain email.

Presigned link (expires in 72 hours): https://one.example-presign.com/upload/xyz

Note for auditors: once the files are uploaded we'll run a quick SHA256 checksum on files and record the hash in our intake. Please include the doc ids in the mapping spreadsheet cells B2:B20 to simplify our reconciliation.

Appreciate the tight turnaround.

—Lena
attachments: none

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@novafinance.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 March 2027 14:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal: source verification for SOC 2 artifacts

Lena — upload completed to the presigned link this morning at 09:22 PT. Files uploaded (prefix NOVA-RE):
- NOVA-RE_soc2-bridge-summary.pdf (attached hash recorded: sha256:3a4b...)
- NOVA-RE_sig-caiaq-mapping.xlsx (doc ids in B2:B18 populated)
- NOVA-RE_presign-log.txt (upload log)

I've placed a copy in our security Drive at /security/soc2/uploads/novafinance-20270310 and flagged Mateo for sign-off. The upload-instructions.txt you shared was followed (no evidence in email). If you need the full SHA256 checksums or a notarized timestamp, say the word and we'll generate a signed manifest.

Thanks — Priyom
Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: NOVA-RE_soc2-bridge-summary.pdf, NOVA-RE_sig-caiaq-mapping.xlsx, NOVA-RE_presign-log.txt
